title: backend-skeleton decision event
description: D-decision-event-log: one line of a .sbf/<feature_id>.decisions.jsonl file, appended by lib/decision-log.mjs's appendDecisionEvent() every time one of the four spec-side decision files (contract-resolution, cross-feature-resolution, impact-resolution, patch-approvals) is written -- mirrors gate-event.schema.json's own shape and resilience contract exactly (append-only JSONL, a corrupt/invalid line is skipped with a warning at read time, never a hard failure). Deliberately NOT a unified record type across the four decision files themselves -- their on-disk shapes stay exactly as they were (different upsert semantics: contract waivers are append-if-absent, impact dispositions are replace-by-key, and forcing either into the other would be the over-unification this design explicitly rejected). `subject` is a discriminated union keyed on `kind`, carrying that decision kind's REAL key object verbatim -- never flattened to a string -- because a generic string key is exactly how the anti-wildcard property every one of the four already enforces (a decision covers ONE exact subject, never a class of future subjects) would eventually erode. This log is machine-local (.sbf/ is gitignored-by-convention) and is NOT tamper-evident on its own; its evidentiary value comes from being rolled up into a SIGNED gate-export attestation (see D-attestation-payload-completeness), exactly as gates.*.history already is.

subject.description: The exact key object for this decision, shaped per `kind` -- never a flattened string.
